definition.paired_sampling_law: Held-out clean input encoded once; hold deterministic code through reverse steps 4,3,2,1 from independent N(0,I), fresh Gaussian eta every step; shuffle code rows with identical start and reverse eta
definition.sampling_law: Public DDGAN [1,.9,.5,.05,.0001]; N(0,I) terminal start; fresh independent learned-MoG latent/kernel noise and Gaussian reverse noise at EVERY step; eight heldout time/observation transition panels; separate paired cohort: encode held-out clean input once, hold its deterministic AE code through all four reverse steps from independent N(0,I), fresh Gaussian reverse noise each step; shuffled-code control shares identical start and reverse noise
definition.training_law: independent D/G clean mixture draws, independent uniform per-row timestep 1..4; public DDGAN.forward_pair; predicted-clean G and public DDGAN.reverse with independent Gaussian eta; public adversarial loss+critic penalty+recipe prior regularization; plus weighted public ParticleEncoding.reconstruction_loss of clean input from G(xt,AE(clean),t); shared encoder query/offset network; bind union of independently sampled and encoded prior rows
